verses.saheeh: By those [angels] lined up in rows
verses.khattab: By those ˹angels˺ lined up in ranks
verses.jalalayn: ﻿By those who are ranged in ranks — [by] the angels who range their souls in worship or their wings in the air awaiting their orders;
verses.romanUrdu: Qataar dar qataar saff baandhne walon ki kasam

verses.saheeh: And those who drive [the clouds]
verses.khattab: and those who diligently drive ˹the clouds˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and the drivers who drive [away], the angels who drive the clouds;
verses.romanUrdu: Phir unki kasam jo daatne phatkaar ne waley hain

verses.saheeh: And those who recite the message,
verses.khattab: and those who recite the Reminder
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and those who recite, that is to say, the readers of the Qur'an, they recite it, by way remembrance (dhikran is a verbal noun referring to [the action of] al-tāliyāt, ‘those who recite’).
verses.romanUrdu: Phir unki kasam jo kalaam e naseehat sunane waley hain

verses.saheeh: Indeed, your God is One,
verses.khattab: Surely your God is One
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Indeed your God, O people of Mecca, is certainly One,
verses.romanUrdu: Tumhara mabood e haqiqi bas ek hi hai

verses.uthmani: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَشَٰرِقِ
verses.indopak: رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ الۡمَشَارِقِ ؕ
verses.transliteration: rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma warabbu almashariqi
verses.saheeh: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them and Lord of the sunrises.
verses.khattab: ˹He is˺ the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between, and the Lord of all points of sunrise
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, and Lord of the sun’s risings, that is, as well as the sun’s settings — each day it [the sun] has a rising and a setting.
verses.romanUrdu: Woh jo zameen aur aasmaano ka aur tamaam un cheezon ka maalik hai jo zameen o aasmaan mein hain, aur saarey mashrikon(easts) ka maalik

verses.uthmani: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلْكَوَاكِبِ
verses.indopak: اِنَّا زَيَّنَّا السَّمَآءَ الدُّنۡيَا بِزِيۡنَةِ اۨلۡكَوَاكِبِ ۙ
verses.transliteration: inna zayyanna alssamaa alddunya bizeenatin alkawakibi
verses.saheeh: Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars
verses.khattab: Indeed, We have adorned the lowest heaven with the stars for decoration
verses.jalalayn: ﻿We have indeed adorned the lowest heaven with an adornment, the stars, that is to say, [adorned] with their light or with them [the stars] (the genitive annexation [bi-zīnati’l-kawākib] is for explication; similarly [explicative] is the reading of bi-zīnatin, ‘with an adornment’, with nunation, [the adornment] explained as being ‘the stars’);
verses.romanUrdu: Humne aasmaan e duniya ko taaron ki zeenat se aarasta (adorn) kiya hai

verses.saheeh: And as protection against every rebellious devil
verses.khattab: and ˹for˺ protection from every rebellious devil
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and to guard (wa-hifzan is in the accusative because of an implied verb) that is to say, ‘We have guarded it with meteors’, from every (min kulli is semantically connected to the implied verb) any rebellious devil, who is a transgressor, in rebellion against obedience.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur har shaytan sarkash se isko mehfooz kardiya hai

verses.uthmani: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٍۢ
verses.indopak: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُوۡنَ اِلَى الۡمَلَاِ الۡاَعۡلٰى وَيُقۡذَفُوۡنَ مِنۡ كُلِّ جَانِبٍ ۖ
verses.transliteration: la yassamma'oona ila almalai ala'la wayuqthafoona min kulli janibin
verses.saheeh: [So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side,
verses.khattab: They cannot listen to the highest assembly ˹of angels˺ for they are pelted from every side
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They, namely, the devils (lā yasma‘ūna, this is [the beginning of] a new sentence) cannot listen in — this ‘listening’ of theirs represents that faculty with which they memorise [what they hear] — on the High Council, the angels in the heavens (the [normally transitive verb] al-samā‘ is complemented with the preposition ilā, ‘to’ [here ‘in on’] because it includes the additional sense of ‘paying attention’ [while listening]; a variant reading has yassamma‘una, which is actually yatasamma‘ūna, the tā’ have been assimilated with the sīn), for they, the devils, are pelted, with flames, from every side, from the remotest regions of the heavens,
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh shayateen mala-e-aala (High Council) ki baatein nahin sun saktey, har taraf se maarey aur haankey jatey hain

verses.saheeh: Repelled; and for them is a constant punishment,
verses.khattab: ˹fiercely˺ driven away. And they will suffer an everlasting torment
verses.jalalayn: ﻿to repel [them] (duhūran is a verbal noun from daharahu, meaning, ‘he repelled him, driving him away’; it is an object denoting reason) and theirs, in the Hereafter, is an everlasting chastisement;
verses.romanUrdu: Aur inke liye paiham azaaab hai

verses.uthmani: إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ ٱلْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌۭ ثَاقِبٌۭ
verses.indopak: اِلَّا مَنۡ خَطِفَ الۡخَطۡفَةَ فَاَتۡبَعَهٗ شِهَابٌ ثَاقِبٌ
verses.transliteration: illa man khatifa alkhatfata faatba'ahu shihabun thaqibun
verses.saheeh: Except one who snatches [some words] by theft, but they are pursued by a burning flame, piercing [in brightness].
verses.khattab: But whoever manages to stealthily eavesdrop is ˹instantly˺ pursued by a piercing flare
verses.jalalayn: ﻿except him who snatches a fragment (al-khatfa is the verbal noun, that is to say, ‘[that] one time’; the exceptive clause refers to the subject [of the verb] yasma‘ūna, in other words, ‘the only devil that is able to listen is the one that hears a word from the angels and snatches it away quickly’) and who is then pursued by a piercing flame (shihāb is a meteor) that pierces him, or burns him or robs him of his senses.
verses.romanUrdu: Taaham agar koi inmein se kuch ley uday to ek teiz shola uska peecha karta hai

verses.uthmani: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَم مَّنْ خَلَقْنَآ ۚ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُم مِّن طِينٍۢ لَّازِبٍۭ
verses.indopak: فَاسۡتَفۡتِهِمۡ اَهُمۡ اَشَدُّ خَلۡقًا اَمۡ مَّنۡ خَلَقۡنَا ؕ اِنَّا خَلَقۡنٰهُمۡ مِّنۡ طِيۡنٍ لَّازِبٍ
verses.transliteration: faistaftihim ahum ashaddu khalqan am man khalaqna inna khalaqnahum min teenin lazibin
verses.saheeh: Then inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Are they a stronger [or more difficult] creation or those [others] We have created?" Indeed, We created men from sticky clay.
verses.khattab: So ask them ˹O Prophet˺, which is harder to create: them or other marvels of Our creation? Indeed, We created them from a sticky clay
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So ask them, in other words, inquire of the people of Mecca for affirmation or by way of rebuke: Are they stronger as a creation, or those [others] whom We created?, of angels, heavens, the two earths and all that is in them (the use of man, ‘those whom’ [in man khalaqnā] indicates that the reference is predominantly to [other] rational creatures). Indeed We created them, that is, their origin, Adam, from a viscous clay, that sticks to the hand. The [intended] meaning is that their physical make-up is fragile so let them not behave arrogantly by rejecting the Prophet and the Qur'an, a fact which will result in their — easily accomplished — destruction.
verses.romanUrdu: Ab insey pucho, inki paidaish zyada mushkil hai ya un cheezon ki jo humne paida kar rakkhi hain? Inko to humne leis daar gaaray(sticky clay/chickni mitti) se paida kiya hai

verses.saheeh: But you wonder, while they mock,
verses.khattab: In fact, you are astonished ˹by their denial˺, while they ridicule ˹you˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Nay, but (bal is for effecting a transition from one object to another, which in this case is to inform of his state and theirs) you marvel, (‘ajibta) addressing the Prophet (s), that is, [you marvel] that they deny you, while they engage in ridicule, at your marvelling,
verses.romanUrdu: Tum (Allah ki qudrat ke karishmon par) hairan ho aur yeh iska mazaak uda rahey hain

verses.saheeh: And when they are reminded, they remember not.
verses.khattab: When they are reminded, they are never mindful
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and [even] when they are reminded, [when] they are admonished with the Qur'an, they are not mindful, they do not heed the admonition,
verses.romanUrdu: Samjhaya jaata hai to samajh kar nahin detey

verses.saheeh: And when they see a sign, they ridicule
verses.khattab: And whenever they see a sign, they make fun of it
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and when they see a sign, such as the splitting of the moon [cf. Q. 54:1], they make it an object of ridicule, they deride it.
verses.romanUrdu: Koi nishani dekhte hain to usey thatton (mazaak/mock) mein udatey hain

verses.uthmani: وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ
verses.indopak: وَقَالُوۡۤا اِنۡ هٰذَاۤ اِلَّا سِحۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ ۖ ۚ
verses.transliteration: waqaloo in hatha illa sihrun mubeenun
verses.saheeh: And say, "This is not but obvious magic.
verses.khattab: saying, “This is nothing but pure magic
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And they say, regarding it: ‘This is nothing but manifest sorcery — and they say in denial of the Resurrection —
verses.romanUrdu: Aur kehte hain “ yeh to sareeh jaadu hai

verses.uthmani: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
verses.indopak: ءَاِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُـنَّا تُرَابًا وَّعِظَامًا ءَاِنَّا لَمَبۡعُوۡثُوۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: aitha mitna wakunna turaban wa'ithaman ainna lamab'oothoona
verses.saheeh: When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
verses.khattab: When we are dead and reduced to dust and bones, will we really be resurrected
verses.jalalayn: ﻿When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we indeed be resurrected? (In both places [sc. a-idhā and a-innā] either pronounce both hamzas, or read without pronouncing the second one and inserting an alif between them, in both cases).
verses.romanUrdu: Bhala kahin aisa ho sakta hai ke jab hum mar chuke hon aur mitti ban jayein aur haddiyon ka panjar reh jaye us waqt hum phir zinda karke utha khade kiye jayein

verses.saheeh: And our forefathers [as well]?"
verses.khattab: And our forefathers as well?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And our forefathers too?’ (read aw ābā’unā indicating a supplement; or read a-wa-ābā’unā as an interrogative, effecting the supplement with the wāw; so that what is being supplemented is either the inna together with its subject [sc. a-inna la-mab‘ūthūna], or the subject [of the verb] la-mab‘ūthūna, in which case the interrogative hamza is a separator).
verses.romanUrdu: Aur kya hamare agle waqton ke aaba o ajdaad bhi uthaye jayenge?”

verses.saheeh: Say, "Yes, and you will be [rendered] contemptible."
verses.khattab: Say, “Yes! And you will be fully humbled.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Say: ‘Yes, you will be resurrected, and you will be utterly humiliated!’
verses.romanUrdu: (insey kaho haan, aur tum) khuda ke muqable mein baybas ho

verses.uthmani: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
verses.indopak: فَاِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجۡرَةٌ وَّاحِدَةٌ فَاِذَا هُمۡ يَنۡظُرُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: fainnama hiya zajratun wahidatun faitha hum yanthuroona
verses.saheeh: It will be only one shout, and at once they will be observing.
verses.khattab: It will only take one Blast, then at once they will see ˹it all˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿For it will be only (innamā hiya, this [hiya] is a demonstrative pronoun explained by [the following, zajratun) a single cry and, lo! they, all creatures, will be, alive, watching, [to see] what will be done with them.
verses.romanUrdu: Bas ek hi jhidki hogi aur yakayak yeh apni aankhon se (woh sab kuch jiski khabar di jaa rahi hai) dekh rahey hongey

verses.transliteration: waqaloo ya waylana hatha yawmu alddeeni
verses.saheeh: They will say, "O woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense."
verses.khattab: They will cry, “Oh, woe to us! This is the Day of Judgment!”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And they, the disbelievers, will say, ‘O (yā is for calling attention) woe to us!’, [O] our destruction [is here] (waylanā is a verbal noun without any [regular] verbal conjugation). And the angels will say to them: ‘This is the Day of Retribution’, the Day of Reckoning and Requital.
verses.romanUrdu: Us waqt yeh kahengey “ haaye hamari kambakhti , yeh to yaum ul jaza hai”

verses.uthmani: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.indopak: هٰذَا يَوۡمُ الۡفَصۡلِ الَّذِىۡ كُنۡتُمۡ بِهٖ تُكَذِّبُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: hatha yawmu alfasli allathee kuntum bihi tukaththiboona
verses.saheeh: [They will be told], "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny."
verses.khattab: ˹They will be told,˺ “This is the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision which you used to deny.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿‘This is the Day of Judgement, between [all] creatures, that you used to deny!’
verses.romanUrdu: “yeh wahi faisley ka din hai jisey tum jhutlaya karte thay”

verses.uthmani: ٱحْشُرُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ وَأَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ
verses.indopak: اُحۡشُرُوا الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا وَاَزۡوَاجَهُمۡ وَمَا كَانُوۡا يَعۡبُدُوۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: ohshuroo allatheena thalamoo waazwajahum wama kanoo ya'budoona
verses.saheeh: [The angels will be ordered], "Gather those who committed wrong, their kinds, and what they used to worship
verses.khattab: ˹Allah will say to the angels,˺ “Gather ˹all˺ the wrongdoers along with their peers, and whatever they used to worship
verses.jalalayn: ﻿It is then said to the angels: ‘Gather those who did wrong, to their own souls through idolatry, together with their mates, their associates from among the devils, and what they used to worship,
verses.romanUrdu: (Hukum hoga) gher lao sab zaalimon aur unke saathiyon aur un maboodon ko jinki woh khuda ko chodh kar bandagi kiya karte thay

verses.uthmani: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهْدُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.indopak: مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ فَاهۡدُوۡهُمۡ اِلٰى صِرَاطِ الۡجَحِيۡمِ
verses.transliteration: min dooni allahi faihdoohum ila sirati aljaheemi
verses.saheeh: Other than Allah, and guide them to the path of Hellfire
verses.khattab: instead of Allah, then lead them ˹all˺ to the path of Hell
verses.jalalayn: ﻿besides God, in other words, other than Him, in the way of graven images, and lead them, direct them and drive them, to the path of Hell, the way to the Fire.
verses.romanUrdu: Phir un sab ko jahannum ka raasta dikhao

verses.saheeh: And stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned."
verses.khattab: And detain them, for they must be questioned.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿But [first] stop them, detain them on the path, for they must be questioned, about all their sayings and deeds, and it will be said to them in rebuke:
verses.romanUrdu: Aur zara inhein thehrao, inse kuch puchna hai

verses.saheeh: [They will be asked], "What is [wrong] with you? Why do you not help each other?"
verses.khattab: ˹Then they will be asked,˺ “What is the matter with you that you can no longer help each other?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿“What is wrong with you that you do not help one another?”, as was the case with you in this world. And it will be said to them:
verses.romanUrdu: “Kya ho gaya tumhein, ab kyun ek dusre ki madad nahin karte

verses.saheeh: But they, that Day, are in surrender.
verses.khattab: In fact, on that Day they will be ˹fully˺ submissive
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Nay, but today they offer complete submission, [they are] compliant, abased.
verses.romanUrdu: (Arey, aaj to yeh apne aap ko) aur ek dusre ko hawaliye (surrender) kiye de rahe hain”

verses.saheeh: And they will approach one another blaming each other.
verses.khattab: They will turn on each other, throwing blame
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And some of them will turn to others, questioning each other, blaming one another and disputing.
verses.romanUrdu: Iske baad yeh ek dusre ki taraf mudenge aur baham takrar shuru kar dengey

verses.uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَأْتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
verses.indopak: قَالُوۡۤا اِنَّكُمۡ كُنۡتُمۡ تَاۡتُوۡنَنَا عَنِ الۡيَمِيۡنِ
verses.saheeh: They will say, "Indeed, you used to come at us from the right."
verses.khattab: The misled will say, “It was you who deluded us away from what is right.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They, that is, the followers among them, will say, to those whom they followed: ‘Indeed you used to approach us from the right’, in other words, from that aspect in which we used to trust you, for you used to swear that you followed the truth, and so we believed you and we followed you — in other words, ‘Indeed, you have led us astray!’
verses.romanUrdu: pairvi karne waley apne peshwaon[leaders] se) kahenge, “Tum hamare paas seedhay rukh se aate thay”

verses.saheeh: The oppressors will say, "Rather, you [yourselves] were not believers,
verses.khattab: The misleaders will reply, “No! You disbelieved on your own
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They, the ones who were followed, say, to them [the followers]: ‘On the contrary! You were [simply] not believers, for it would only be true that we led you astray if you had actually been believers [in the first place] and then rejected faith and followed us.
verses.romanUrdu: Woh jawaab dengey “nahin balke tum khud iman laney waley na thay

verses.uthmani: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَٰنٍۭ ۖ بَلْ كُنتُمْ قَوْمًۭا طَٰغِينَ
verses.indopak: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيۡكُمۡ مِّنۡ سُلۡطٰنِ ۚ بَلۡ كُنۡتُمۡ قَوۡمًا طٰغِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: wama kana lana 'alaykum min sultanin bal kuntum qawman tagheena
verses.saheeh: And we had over you no authority, but you were a transgressing people.
verses.khattab: We had no authority over you. In fact, you yourselves were a transgressing people
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And we did not have any warrant, any sway or power, over you, to compel you to follow us. Nay, but you [yourselves] were a rebellious folk, astray, like us.
verses.romanUrdu: Hamara tumpar koi zoar na tha, tum khud hi sarkash log thay

verses.uthmani: فَحَقَّ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَآ ۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ
verses.indopak: فَحَقَّ عَلَيۡنَا قَوۡلُ رَبِّنَآ ۖ اِنَّا لَذَآٮِٕقُوۡنَ
verses.saheeh: So the word of our Lord has come into effect upon us; indeed, we will taste [punishment].
verses.khattab: The decree of our Lord has come to pass against us ˹all˺: we will certainly taste ˹the punishment˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So our Lord’s Words, of chastisement — namely, His Words: ‘Verily I shall fill Hell with jinn and mankind together’ [Q. 11:119] — have become due against us, both. Indeed we shall, both, taste, the chastisement with these Words — which prompts them to say:
verses.romanUrdu: Aakhir e kaar hum apne Rubb ke is farmaan ke mustahiq ho gaye ke hum azaab ka maza chakhne waley hain

verses.saheeh: And we led you to deviation; indeed, we were deviators."
verses.khattab: We caused you to deviate, for we ourselves were deviant.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So we led you astray — the reason for which is given by their saying — indeed we [ourselves] were astray’.
verses.romanUrdu: So humne tumko behkaya, hum khud behke huye thay”

verses.saheeh: So indeed they, that Day, will be sharing in the punishment.
verses.khattab: Surely on that Day they will ˹all˺ share in the punishment
verses.jalalayn: ﻿God, exalted be He, says: So they on that day, the Day of Resurrection, will share in the chastisement, for they shared in the error.
verses.romanUrdu: Is taraah woh sab us roz azaab mein mushtarik (shareek) hongey

verses.saheeh: Indeed, that is how We deal with the criminals.
verses.khattab: That is certainly how We deal with the wicked
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Indeed so, in the same way that We deal with these, We deal with sinners, other than these, in other words, We chastise both of them the followers and those who were followed.
verses.romanUrdu: Hum mujreemon ke saath yahi kuch kiya karte hain

verses.uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوٓا۟ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
verses.indopak: اِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡۤا اِذَا قِيۡلَ لَهُمۡ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ ۙ يَسۡتَكۡبِرُوۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: innahum kanoo itha qeela lahum la ilaha illa allahu yastakbiroona
verses.saheeh: Indeed they, when it was said to them, "There is no deity but Allah," were arrogant
verses.khattab: For whenever it was said to them ˹in the world˺, “There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Allah,” they acted arrogantly
verses.jalalayn: ﻿For truly it was they who, in other words, [it was] these [sinners] who — given the context that follows — when it was said to them, ‘There is no god except God’, used to be scornful,
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh woh log thay ke jab unsey kaha jata “Allah ke siwa koi maabood e barhaqq nahin hai” to yeh ghamand mein aa jatey thay

verses.uthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍۢ مَّجْنُونٍۭ
verses.indopak: وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ اَٮِٕنَّا لَتٰرِكُوۡۤا اٰلِهَـتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍ مَّجۡـنُوۡنٍ ؕ
verses.saheeh: And were saying, "Are we to leave our gods for a mad poet?"
verses.khattab: and argued, “Should we really abandon our gods for a mad poet?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and would say, ‘Are we to abandon our gods for a mad poet?’, that is, for the sake of what Muhammad (s) says? (as regards the hamzas [in a-innā, ‘are we’], the same applies as mentioned above).
verses.romanUrdu: Aur kehte thay “kya hum ek shayar majnoon (dewane) ki khaatir apne maboodon ko chodh dein?”

verses.saheeh: Rather, the Prophet has come with the truth and confirmed the [previous] messengers.
verses.khattab: In fact, he came with the truth, confirming ˹earlier˺ messengers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿God, exalted be He, says: Nay, but he has brought [them] the truth and confirmed the [earlier] messengers, namely, those who had also brought this [truth], which is that there is no god except God.
verses.romanUrdu: Halaanke woh haqq lekar aaya tha aur usne Rasoolon ki tasdeeq ki thi

verses.saheeh: Indeed, you [disbelievers] will be tasters of the painful punishment,
verses.khattab: You will certainly taste the painful torment
verses.jalalayn: ﻿‘You shall certainly (there is a shift from the third person address [to the second] here) taste the painful chastisement,
verses.romanUrdu: (Ab unse kaha jayega ke) tum laaziman dardnaak saza ka maza chakhne waley ho

verses.uthmani: وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.indopak: وَمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ اِلَّا مَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: wama tujzawna illa ma kuntum ta'maloona
verses.saheeh: And you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do -
verses.khattab: and will only be rewarded for what you used to do
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and you will only be requited, the requital for, what you used to do’.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur tumhein jo badla bhi diya jaa raha hai unhi aamaal ka diya ja raha hai jo tum karte rahey ho

verses.saheeh: But not the chosen servants of Allah.
verses.khattab: But not the chosen servants of Allah
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Except for God’s sincere servants, namely, the believers (the exception clause here is a discontinuous one),
verses.romanUrdu: Magar Allah ke cheeda (chune huey/chosen) banday (is anjaam e badd se) mehfooz hongey

verses.saheeh: Those will have a provision determined -
verses.khattab: They will have a known provision
verses.jalalayn: ﻿whose requital is mentioned in His saying: For them there will be, in Paradise, a distinct provision, morning and evening —
verses.romanUrdu: Unke liye jaana bujha rizq (known provision) hai

verses.saheeh: Fruits; and they will be honored
verses.khattab: fruits ˹of every type˺. And they will be honoured
verses.jalalayn: ﻿fruits (fawākihu either substitutes for rizqun, or is an explication thereof) here these [fruits] represent what is eaten for delight and not for the sake of preserving one’s health [as in this world], for the inhabitants of Paradise are in no need of preserving it given that their bodies will be created to be everlasting — and they will honoured, with God’s reward, glory be to Him, exalted be He,
verses.romanUrdu: Har tarah ki lazeez cheezein

verses.saheeh: In gardens of pleasure
verses.khattab: in the Gardens of Bliss
verses.jalalayn: ﻿in the Gardens of Bliss,
verses.romanUrdu: Aur niyamat bhari jannatein

verses.saheeh: On thrones facing one another.
verses.khattab: facing each other on thrones
verses.jalalayn: ﻿[reclining] upon couches, facing one another, so that they do not see the back of one another;
verses.romanUrdu: Jinmein woh izzat ke saath rakkhey jayenge, takhaton par aamne saamne baithenge

verses.saheeh: There will be circulated among them a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring,
verses.khattab: A drink ˹of pure wine˺ will be passed around to them from a flowing stream
verses.jalalayn: ﻿they are served from all round, each one of them [is so served], with a cup (ka’san, [this denotes] the vessel with the drink in it) from a spring, of wine that flows along the ground like streams of water,
verses.romanUrdu: Sharaab ke chamson (springs) se sagar (cups) bhar bhar kar unke darmiyan phiraye jayenge

verses.saheeh: White and delicious to the drinkers;
verses.khattab: crystal-white, delicious to drink
verses.jalalayn: ﻿white, whiter than milk, delicious to the drinkers, in contrast to the wine of this world which is distasteful to drink,
verses.romanUrdu: Chamakti hui sharaab, jo peene waalon ke liye lazzat hogi

verses.uthmani: لَا فِيهَا غَوْلٌۭ وَلَا هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنزَفُونَ
verses.indopak: لَا فِيۡهَا غَوۡلٌ وَّلَا هُمۡ عَنۡهَا يُنۡزَفُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: la feeha ghawlun wala hum 'anha yunzafoona
verses.saheeh: No bad effect is there in it, nor from it will they be intoxicated.
verses.khattab: It will neither harm ˹them˺, nor will they be intoxicated by it
verses.jalalayn: ﻿wherein there is neither madness, nothing to snatch away their minds, nor will they be spent by it (read yunzafūna or yunzifūna, from [1st form] nazafa or [4th form] anzafa, said of one drinking, in other words, they are [not] inebriated [by it], in contrast to the wine of this world),
verses.romanUrdu: Na unke jism ko ussey koi zarar hoga aur na unki aqal ussey kharab hogi

verses.saheeh: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances, with large, [beautiful] eyes,
verses.khattab: And with them will be maidens of modest gaze and gorgeous eyes
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and with them will be maidens of restrained glances, who reserved their glances [exclusively] for their spouses and do not look upon any other — because of the beauty they [the maidens] see in them — with beautiful eyes (‘īn means with large and beautiful eyes),
verses.romanUrdu: Aur unke paas nigahein bachane wali, khoobsurat aankhon wali auratein hongi

verses.saheeh: As if they were [delicate] eggs, well-protected.
verses.khattab: as if they were pristine pearls
verses.jalalayn: ﻿as if they were, in terms of [the starkness of their white] colour, hidden eggs, of ostriches, sheltered by their feathers from dust, the colour being that whiteness with a hint of pallor, which is the most beautiful of female complexions.
verses.romanUrdu: Aisi naazuk jaise andey (egg) ke chilke ke nichey chupi hui jhilli

verses.saheeh: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
verses.khattab: Then they will turn to one another inquisitively
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Some of them, some of the inhabitants of Paradise, will turn to others, questioning each other, regarding what they experienced in the [life of the] world.
verses.romanUrdu: Phir woh ek dusre ki taraf mutawajjeh ho kar halaat puchengey

verses.uthmani: قَالَ قَآئِلٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ إِنِّى كَانَ لِى قَرِينٌۭ
verses.indopak: قَالَ قَآٮِٕلٌ مِّنۡهُمۡ اِنِّىۡ كَانَ لِىۡ قَرِيۡنٌ ۙ
verses.transliteration: qala qailun minhum innee kana lee qareenun
verses.saheeh: A speaker among them will say, "Indeed, I had a companion [on earth]
verses.khattab: One of them will say, “I once had a companion ˹in the world˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿One of them will say, ‘Indeed I had a comrade, a companion who used to reject [the idea of] resurrection,
verses.romanUrdu: Unmein se ek kahega, “duniya mein mera ek hum nahseen (companion) tha

verses.saheeh: Who would say, 'Are you indeed of those who believe
verses.khattab: who used to ask ˹me˺, ‘Do you actually believe ˹in resurrection˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿who used to say, to me in reproach, “Are you really among those who affirm as truth, the Resurrection [and],
verses.romanUrdu: Jo mujhse kaha karta tha, kya tum bhi tasdeeq karne walon mein se ho

verses.uthmani: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ
verses.indopak: ءَاِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَّعِظَامًا ءَاِنَّا لَمَدِيۡنُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: aitha mitna wakunna turaban wa'ithaman ainna lamadeenoona
verses.saheeh: That when we have died and become dust and bones, we will indeed be recompensed?'"
verses.khattab: When we are dead and reduced to dust and bones, will we really be brought to judgment?’”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿[that] when we are dead and have become dust and bones, we shall actually be called to account?” ’, that we shall be requited and reckoned with — he rejects [the truth of] this as well (as regards all three instances of the hamzas [sc. a-innaka, a-idhā, and a-innā] what has been mentioned above [applies]).
verses.romanUrdu: Kya waqayi jab hum mar chuke hongey aur mitti ho jayenge aur haddiyon ka panjar bankar reh jayenge to humein jaza o saza di jayegi

verses.saheeh: He will say, "Would you [care to] look?"
verses.khattab: He will ˹then˺ ask, “Would you care to see ˹his fate˺?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He, the one speaking, says, to his brethren [in Paradise], ‘Will you have a look?’, together with me into the Fire, to see his condition — but they will say, ‘No’.
verses.romanUrdu: Ab kya aap log dekhna chahte hain ke woh sahib ab kahan hain?”

verses.saheeh: And he will look and see him in the midst of the Hellfire.
verses.khattab: Then he ˹and the others˺ will look and spot him in the midst of the Hellfire
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Then he, that speaker, will take a look, through one of the apertures in Paradise, and he will catch sight of him, that is, he will see his comrade, in the centre of Hell, in the middle of the Fire.
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh keh kar junhi woh jhukega to jahannum ki gehrayi mein usko dekh lega

verses.saheeh: He will say, "By Allah, you almost ruined me.
verses.khattab: He will ˹then˺ say, “By Allah! You nearly ruined me
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He will say, to him, acknowledging that he [the latter] deserves his fate: ‘By God! You very nearly destroyed me, you [almost] ruined me through your misguidance (in, this has been softened from the hardened form [inna]).
verses.romanUrdu: Aur ussey khitaab karke kahega “khuda ki kasam, tu to mujhey tabaah hi kar dene wala tha

verses.uthmani: وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّى لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْضَرِينَ
verses.indopak: وَلَوۡلَا نِعۡمَةُ رَبِّىۡ لَـكُنۡتُ مِنَ الۡمُحۡضَرِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: walawla ni'matu rabbee lakuntu mina almuhdareena
verses.saheeh: If not for the favor of my Lord, I would have been of those brought in [to Hell].
verses.khattab: Had it not been for the grace of my Lord, I ˹too˺ would have certainly been among those brought ˹to Hell˺.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And had it not been for the favour of my Lord, His grace to me in giving me faith, I [too] would have been of those arraigned’, with you, in the Fire. The inhabitants of Paradise will say:
verses.romanUrdu: Mere Rubb ka fazal shamil e haal na hota to aaj main bhi un logon mein se hota jo pakde huey aaye hain

verses.saheeh: Then, are we not to die
verses.khattab: ˹Then he will ask his fellow believers,˺ “Can you imagine that we will never die
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Do we then not die [anymore],
verses.romanUrdu: Accha to kya ab hum marne waley nahin hain

verses.uthmani: إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
verses.indopak: اِلَّا مَوۡتَتَـنَا الۡاُوۡلٰى وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُعَذَّبِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: illa mawtatana aloola wama nahnu bimu'aththabeena
verses.saheeh: Except for our first death, and we will not be punished?"
verses.khattab: except our first death, nor be punished ˹like the others˺?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿aside from our first death, that is, the one [which we suffered] in this world, and are we not to be chastised?’ — this interrogative statement is one made out of [sheer] delight and in order to speak [at length] of the graces of God, exalted be He, in [His] granting of everlasting life and refraining from inflicting any punishment.
verses.romanUrdu: Maut jo humein aani thi woh bas pehle aa chuki? Ab humein koi azaab nahin hona?”

verses.saheeh: Indeed, this is the great attainment.
verses.khattab: This is truly the ultimate triumph
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Truly this, that has mentioned [as being the reward] for the inhabitants of Paradise, is indeed the mighty success.
verses.romanUrdu: Yakeenan yahi azeem o shaan kaamiyabi hai

verses.saheeh: For the like of this let the workers [on earth] work.
verses.khattab: For such ˹honour˺ all should strive
verses.jalalayn: ﻿For the like of this let [all] the workers work — it is said that this is said to them, or it is what they say [themselves].
verses.romanUrdu: Aisi hi kamiyabi ke liye amal karne walon ko amal karna chahiye

verses.uthmani: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌۭ نُّزُلًا أَمْ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
verses.indopak: اَذٰ لِكَ خَيۡرٌ نُّزُلًا اَمۡ شَجَرَةُ الزَّقُّوۡمِ
verses.transliteration: athalika khayrun nuzulan am shajaratu alzzaqqoomi
verses.saheeh: Is Paradise a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqum?
verses.khattab: Is this ˹bliss˺ a better accommodation or the tree of Zaqqûm
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Is that, which is mentioned to them, a better hospitality (nuzul, denotes what is prepared for one who is being received as a guest and so forth) or the Zaqqūm tree, that is prepared for the inhabitants of the Fire — it is the vilest and most bitter tree of the Tihāma region, which God causes to grow in the Fire, as will be stated shortly.
verses.romanUrdu: Bolo, yeh ziyafat acchi hai ya zakkhum ka darakht

verses.saheeh: Indeed, We have made it a torment for the wrongdoers.
verses.khattab: We have surely made it a test for the wrongdoers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿We have indeed made it, for that reason [sc. its being a tree in the Fire], a trial for the wrongdoers?, namely, [for] the disbelievers of Mecca, for they said, ‘Fire consumes trees so how can it make them grow forth?’
verses.romanUrdu: Humne us darakht ko zaalimon ke liye fitna bana diya hai

verses.uthmani: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌۭ تَخْرُجُ فِىٓ أَصْلِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.indopak: اِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌ تَخۡرُجُ فِىۡۤ اَصۡلِ الۡجَحِيۡمِ ۙ
verses.transliteration: innaha shajaratun takhruju fee asli aljaheemi
verses.saheeh: Indeed, it is a tree issuing from the bottom of the Hellfire,
verses.khattab: Indeed, it is a tree that grows in the depths of Hell
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Indeed it is a tree that comes forth from the very source of Hell, in other words, from the depths of Hell, with its branches extending up through all its [different] levels.
verses.romanUrdu: Woh ek darakht hai jo jahannum ki teh se nikalta hai

verses.saheeh: Its emerging fruit as if it was heads of the devils.
verses.khattab: bearing fruit like devils’ heads
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Its spathes, likened to the spathes of a date-palm, are like the heads of devils, [as] vile-looking snakes.
verses.romanUrdu: Uske shagufe (emerging fruit) aise hain jaise shaytano ke sar

verses.uthmani: فَإِنَّهُمْ لَءَاكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ
verses.indopak: فَاِنَّهُمۡ لَاٰكِلُوۡنَ مِنۡهَا فَمٰلِــُٔــوۡنَ مِنۡهَا الۡبُطُوۡنَ ؕ
verses.transliteration: fainnahum laakiloona minha famalioona minha albutoona
verses.saheeh: And indeed, they will eat from it and fill with it their bellies.
verses.khattab: The evildoers will certainly ˹be left to˺ eat from it, filling up their bellies with it
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And indeed they, the disbelievers, will eat of it, despite its vileness, because of the severity of their hunger, and will fill their bellies from it.
verses.romanUrdu: Jahannum ke log usey khayenge aur usi se pait bharengey

verses.uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًۭا مِّنْ حَمِيمٍۢ
verses.indopak: ثُمَّ اِنَّ لَهُمۡ عَلَيۡهَا لَشَوۡبًا مِّنۡ حَمِيۡمٍ ۚ
verses.saheeh: Then indeed, they will have after it a mixture of scalding water.
verses.khattab: Then on top of that they will be given a blend of boiling drink
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Then, lo!, on top of it they will have a brew of boiling water, which they drink and which mixes with what they have eaten and becomes a brew thereof.
verses.romanUrdu: Phir ispar peene ke liye khaulta hua pani milega

verses.saheeh: Then indeed, their return will be to the Hellfire.
verses.khattab: Then they will ultimately return to ˹their place in˺ Hell
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Then indeed their return shall be to Hell-fire — this suggests that they exit from it [only] to drink the boiling water, which is located outside it.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur iske baad unki wapsi usi aatish e dozakh (blazing Hell) ki taraf hogi

verses.saheeh: Indeed they found their fathers astray.
verses.khattab: Indeed, they found their forefathers astray
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Lo! they found their fathers to be astray,
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh woh log hain jinhon ne apne baap dada ko gumraah paya

verses.saheeh: So they hastened [to follow] in their footsteps.
verses.khattab: so they rushed in their footsteps
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and so they are [also now] hurrying in their footsteps: they shall be prodded to follow them and they end up hurrying towards it [Hell-fire].
verses.romanUrdu: Aur unhi ke nakshe qadam par daud chale

verses.saheeh: And there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples,
verses.khattab: And surely most of the earlier generations had strayed before them
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And verily most of the ancients, of past communities, went astray before them,
verses.romanUrdu: Halaanke unse pehle bahut se log gumraah ho chuke thay

verses.saheeh: And We had already sent among them warners.
verses.khattab: although We had certainly sent warners among them
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and We certainly had sent among them warners, in the way of messengers to threaten [them].
verses.romanUrdu: Aur unmein humne tambeeh (warn) karne walay Rasool bheje thay

verses.saheeh: Then look how was the end of those who were warned -
verses.khattab: See then what was the end of those who had been warned
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So behold how was the consequence for them who were warned, namely, the disbelievers: in other words the sequel for them was [that they ended up in] the chastisement;
verses.romanUrdu: Ab dekhlo ke un tambeeh kiye janey walon ka kya anjaam hua

verses.saheeh: But not the chosen servants of Allah.
verses.khattab: But not the chosen servants of Allah
verses.jalalayn: ﻿[all] except God’s sincere servants, namely, the believers, who are saved from chastisement because they were sincere in their worship (mukhlisīna); or (if one reads mukhlasīna) because God has made them sincerely devoted to such [worship].
verses.romanUrdu: Is bad-anjaami se bas Allah ke wahi banday bachay hain jinhein usne apne liye khalis karliya hai

verses.saheeh: And Noah had certainly called Us, and [We are] the best of responders.
verses.khattab: Indeed, Noah cried out to Us, and how excellent are We in responding
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And verily Noah called to Us, when he said, ‘My Lord: I have been overcome, so help [me] [Q. 54:10], and how excellent were the Hearers of the prayer, for him, were We: in other words he invoked Us against his people, so We destroyed them by drowning [them].
verses.romanUrdu: Humko (issey pehle) Nooh ne pukara tha, to dekho ke hum kaise acche jawab dene waley thay

verses.saheeh: And We saved him and his family from the great affliction.
verses.khattab: We delivered him and his family from the great distress
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And We delivered him and his family from the great distress, which was the drowning,
verses.romanUrdu: Humne usko aur uske ghar walon ko karb-e-azeem (badi musibat) se bacha liya

verses.saheeh: And We made his descendants those remaining [on the earth]
verses.khattab: and made his descendants the sole survivors
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and made his descendants the survivors, thus all human beings are descended from him, peace be upon him. He had three sons: Shem (Sām), the ancestor of the Arabs, the Persians and the Byzantines; Ham (Hām), the ancestor of the Negroes; and Japheth (Yāfith), the ancestor of the Turks, the Khazar and [the peoples of] Gog and Magog and [the inhabitants of] such regions.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur usi ki nasal ko baaki rakkha

verses.saheeh: And left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
verses.khattab: And We blessed him ˹with honourable mention˺ among later generations
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And We left, We preserved, for him, fair praise, among posterity: [among] the prophets and communities [after him] until the Day of Resurrection [which is]:
verses.romanUrdu: Aur baad ki nasalon mein iski taarif o tausif chodh di

verses.saheeh: "Peace upon Noah among the worlds."
verses.khattab: “Peace be upon Noah among all peoples.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿‘Peace, from Us, be to Noah among the worlds!’
verses.romanUrdu: Salaam hai Nooh par tamaam duniya walon mein

verses.saheeh: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
verses.khattab: Indeed, this is how We reward the good-doers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Thus indeed, in the way that We requited them, We requite the virtuous.
verses.romanUrdu: Hum neki karne walon ko aisi hi jaza diya karte hain

verses.saheeh: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
verses.khattab: ˹For˺ he was truly one of Our faithful servants
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He was indeed one of Our faithful servants.
verses.romanUrdu: Dar haqeeqat woh hamare momin bandon mein se tha

verses.saheeh: Then We drowned the disbelievers.
verses.khattab: Then We drowned the others
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Then We did drown the others, the disbelievers from among his folk.
verses.romanUrdu: Phir dusre giroh ko humne garq (drown) kardiya

verses.saheeh: And indeed, among his kind was Abraham,
verses.khattab: And indeed, one of those who followed his way was Abraham
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And truly of his adherents, that is, of those who agreed with him on the fundaments of religion, was Abraham, despite the fact that there was a long interval between them, 2640 years, and between them came [the prophets] Hūd and Sālih.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur Nooh hi ke tareeqey par chalne wala Ibrahim tha

verses.saheeh: When he came to his Lord with a sound heart
verses.khattab: ˹Remember˺ when he came to his Lord with a pure heart
verses.jalalayn: ﻿When he came to his Lord, in other words, he continued to follow Him upon coming to Him, with a heart that was pure, of any doubt or the like,
verses.romanUrdu: Jab woh apne Rubb ke huzur qalb e saleem lekar aaya

verses.uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ
verses.indopak: اِذۡ قَالَ لِاَبِيۡهِ وَقَوۡمِهٖ مَاذَا تَعۡبُدُوۡنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: ith qala liabeehi waqawmihi matha ta'budoona
verses.saheeh: [And] when he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?
verses.khattab: and said to his father and his people, “What are you worshipping
verses.jalalayn: ﻿when he said, [while still] in this continuous state of his, to his father and his folk, in reproach: ‘What do — what is it that — you worship?
verses.romanUrdu: Jab usne apne baap aur apni qaum se kaha “yeh kya cheezein hain jinki tum ibadat kar rahey ho

verses.saheeh: Is it falsehood [as] gods other than Allah you desire?
verses.khattab: Is it false gods that you desire instead of Allah
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Is it a calumny (a-ifkan, as regards the two hamzas, the same applies as mentioned before) — gods other than God — that you desire? (ifkan is an object denoting reason; ālihatan is the direct object of turīdūna, ‘you desire’; ifk denotes the worst kind of lie). In other words: do you worship [any] other than God?
verses.romanUrdu: Kya Allah ko chodh kar jhoot ghadey huey maabood chahte ho

verses.saheeh: Then what is your thought about the Lord of the worlds?"
verses.khattab: What then do you expect from the Lord of all worlds?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿What then is your supposition regarding the Lord of the Worlds?’, having worshipped other than Him, [do you think] that He will leave you without punishment? No! They were a people of astrologers. On one occasion, they went out to celebrate a festival of theirs and left their food behind with their idols, claiming that they were securing thereby blessings for it and that they would eat it upon their return. They had said to the lord Abraham: ‘Come out with us’.
verses.romanUrdu: Aakhir Allah Rubb-ul-Aalameen ke baarey mein tumhara kya gumaan hai?”

verses.saheeh: And he cast a look at the stars
verses.khattab: He later looked up to the stars ˹in contemplation˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And he cast a glance at the stars — to delude them into thinking that he relies on them, so that they would then trust him —
verses.romanUrdu: Phir usne taaron par ek nigaah daali

verses.saheeh: And said, "Indeed, I am [about to be] ill."
verses.khattab: then said, “I am really sick.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and said, ‘Indeed I feel [I will be] sick’, that is, I will fall ill.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur kaha meri tabiyat kharaab hai

verses.saheeh: So they turned away from him, departing.
verses.khattab: So they turned their backs on him and went away
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So they went away, to their festival, leaving him behind.
verses.romanUrdu: Chunanche woh log usey chodh kar chale gaye

verses.uthmani: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
verses.indopak: فَرَاغَ اِلٰٓى اٰلِهَتِهِمۡ فَقَالَ اَلَا تَاۡكُلُوۡنَ ۚ
verses.saheeh: Then he turned to their gods and said, "Do you not eat?
verses.khattab: Then he ˹stealthily˺ advanced towards their gods, and said ˹mockingly˺, “Will you not eat ˹your offerings˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Then he turned, he stole away, to their gods, the idols, in front of which the food had been placed, and said, mockingly: ‘Will you not eat? — but they failed to utter [a word].
verses.romanUrdu: Unke peechey woh chupke se unke maboodon ke mandir mein ghus gaya aur bola “aap log khate kyun nahin hain

verses.saheeh: What is [wrong] with you that you do not speak?"
verses.khattab: What is wrong with you that you cannot speak?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He then said: What is wrong with you that you do not speak?’ — but [still] he received no response.
verses.romanUrdu: Kya ho gaya, aap log bolte bhi nahin?”

verses.saheeh: And he turned upon them a blow with [his] right hand.
verses.khattab: Then he swiftly turned on them, striking ˹them˺ with his right hand
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He then turned on them striking [them] with his right hand, with might, smashing them. Those who saw him reported this to [the rest of] his people.
verses.romanUrdu: Iske baad woh unpar pil (toot) pada aur seedhay haath se khoob zarbein lagayi (todhna shuru kiya)

verses.saheeh: Then the people came toward him, hastening.
verses.khattab: Later, his people came rushing towards him ˹furiously˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So they came running towards him, walking hurriedly, and they said to him, ‘We worship them while you smash them?!’
verses.romanUrdu: (Wapas aakar) woh log bhaage bhaage uske paas aaye

verses.saheeh: He said, "Do you worship that which you [yourselves] carve,
verses.khattab: He argued, “How can you worship what you carve ˹with your own hands˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He said, to them in reproach: ‘Do you worship what you [yourselves] have carved, out of stone and other materials, idols,
verses.romanUrdu: Usne kaha “kya tum apni hi tarashi hui cheezon ko poojhte ho

verses.saheeh: While Allah created you and that which you do?"
verses.khattab: when it is Allah Who created you and whatever you do?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿when God created you and whatever you make?’, [whether it be] your act of carving and that which you have carved? So worship Him alone! (the mā [in wa-mā ta‘malūna, ‘and whatever you make’] is that of the verbal noun; but it is also said to introduce a relative clause, or it is adjectivally qualified).
verses.romanUrdu: Halaanke Allah hi ne tumko bhi paida kiya hai aur un cheezon ko bhi jinhein tum banatey ho”

verses.uthmani: قَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ لَهُۥ بُنْيَٰنًۭا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.indopak: قَالُوا ابۡنُوۡا لَهٗ بُنۡيَانًا فَاَلۡقُوۡهُ فِى الۡجَحِيۡمِ
verses.transliteration: qaloo ibnoo lahu bunyanan faalqoohu fee aljaheemi
verses.saheeh: They said, "Construct for him a furnace and throw him into the burning fire."
verses.khattab: They said ˹to one another˺, “Build him a furnace and cast him into the blazing fire.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They said, amongst themselves: ‘Build for him a structure, then fill it with firewood and set it on fire, and when it is ablaze, then cast him into the fierce fire’.
verses.romanUrdu: Unhon ne aapas mein kaha “ iske liya ek alaaw (pyre) tayyar karo aur isey dehakti hui aag ke dhair mein phenk do”

verses.saheeh: And they intended for him a plan, but We made them the most debased.
verses.khattab: And so they sought to harm him, but We made them inferior
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So they sought to outwit him, by flinging him into the fire, so that it may destroy him, but We made them the lowermost, the vanquished, as he came out of the fire unharmed.
verses.romanUrdu: Unhon ne uske khilaf ek karawayi karna chahi thi, magar humne unhi ko nicha dikha diya

verses.uthmani: وَقَالَ إِنِّى ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
verses.indopak: وَقَالَ اِنِّىۡ ذَاهِبٌ اِلٰى رَبِّىۡ سَيَهۡدِيۡنِ
verses.saheeh: And [then] he said, "Indeed, I will go to [where I am ordered by] my Lord; He will guide me.
verses.khattab: He later said, “I am leaving ˹in obedience˺ to my Lord. He will guide me
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And he said, ‘I shall indeed depart to my Lord, I shall emigrating to Him from the abode of disbelief — He will guide me, to the place to which My Lord has commanded that I end up in, and this was Syria. When he reached the Holy Land, he said:
verses.romanUrdu: Ibrahim ne kaha “ main apne Rubb ki taraf jata hoon, wahi meri rehnumayi karega

verses.saheeh: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous."
verses.khattab: My Lord! Bless me with righteous offspring.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿My Lord! Grant me, a child, of the righteous’.
verses.romanUrdu: Aey parwardigar , mujhey ek beta ata kar jo salihon (righteous) mein se ho”

verses.saheeh: So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy.
verses.khattab: So We gave him good news of a forbearing son
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So We gave him the good tidings of a forbearing son.
verses.romanUrdu: (Is dua ke jawab mein)humne usko ek haleem (burdbaar) ladke ki basharat di

wbw.translation: So We gave him the glad tidings

verses.uthmani: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
verses.indopak: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ السَّعۡىَ قَالَ يٰبُنَىَّ اِنِّىۡۤ اَرٰى فِى الۡمَنَامِ اَنِّىۡۤ اَذۡبَحُكَ فَانْظُرۡ مَاذَا تَرٰى ؕ قَالَ يٰۤاَبَتِ افۡعَلۡ مَا تُؤۡمَرُ سَتَجِدُنِىۡۤ اِنۡ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ مِنَ الصّٰبِرِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: falamma balagha ma'ahu alssa'ya qala ya bunayya innee ara fee almanami annee athbahuka faonthur matha tara qala ya abati if'al ma tumaru satajidunee in shaa allahu mina alssabireena
verses.saheeh: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allah wills, of the steadfast."
verses.khattab: Then when the boy reached the age to work with him, Abraham said, “O my dear son! I have seen in a dream that I ˹must˺ sacrifice you. So tell me what you think.” He replied, “O my dear father! Do as you are commanded. Allah willing, you will find me steadfast.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And when he was old enough to walk with him, that is, to go about with him and help him out — this is said to have been [either] at the age of seven or at the age of thirteen — he said, ‘O my dear son, I see, that is, I have seen, in a dream that I shall sacrifice you — and the visions of prophets are [always] true and their actions are [inspired] by the command of God, exalted be He. So see what you think’, of this dream. He consulted him so that he [his son] might accept the idea of being sacrificed and comply with the command for it. He said, ‘O my father (the [final] tā’ [in abati] replaces the yā’ of the genitive [possessive] annexation [yā abī]) do whatever you have been commanded, to do. You shall find me, God willing, of the steadfast’, in this [affair].
verses.romanUrdu: Woh ladka jab uske saath daud dhoop karne ki umar ko pahunch gaya to ( ek roz) Ibrahim ne ussey kaha, “beta, main khwab mein dekhta hoon ke main tujhey zibaah kar raha hoon, ab tu bata, tera kya khayal hai?” usne kaha, “abbajan , jo kuch aapko hukum diya jaa raha hai usey kar daliye, aap insha Allah mujhey saabiron(sabr karne walon) mein se payenge”

verses.saheeh: And when they had both submitted and he put him down upon his forehead,
verses.khattab: Then when they submitted ˹to Allah’s Will˺, and Abraham laid him on the side of his forehead ˹for sacrifice˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And when they had both submitted, [when] they had submitted to and were prepared to comply with God’s command, exalted be He, and he had laid him down on his forehead, [when] he had pushed him down to the ground thereon — every human being has two brows (jabīn) between which is the forehead (jabha); this was at Minā. Abraham passed the knife across his [son’s] throat but it did not do anything, by some impediment of the Divine Power,
verses.romanUrdu: Aakhir ko jab in dono ne sar-e-tasleem kham kardiya aur Ibrahim ne bete ko maathay ke bal gira diya

verses.saheeh: We called to him, "O Abraham,
verses.khattab: We called out to him, “O Abraham
verses.jalalayn: ﻿We called to him, ‘O Abraham!
verses.romanUrdu: Aur humne nida di ke “Aey Ibrahim

wbw.translation: And We called out to him

verses.uthmani: قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ ٱلرُّءْيَآ ۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.indopak: قَدۡ صَدَّقۡتَ الرُّءۡيَا ۚ اِنَّا كَذٰلِكَ نَجۡزِى الۡمُحۡسِنِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: qad saddaqta alrruya inna kathalika najzee almuhsineena
verses.saheeh: You have fulfilled the vision." Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
verses.khattab: You have already fulfilled the vision.” Indeed, this is how We reward the good-doers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Verily you have fulfilled the vision’, by what you have done, in that you were able to go through with the act of sacrifice. In other words, that [which you have done] suffices for you [as redemption] (the statement nādaynāhu, ‘We called to him’, is the response to the lammā, ‘when’, so that the wāw [in wa-nādaynāhu, ‘We called to him’] is extra). So, in the same way that We have rewarded you, do We reward those who are virtuous, to their own souls in obeying the Command [of God], by removing from them their distress.
verses.romanUrdu: Tu nay khwab sach kar dikhaya hum neki karne walon ko aisi hi jaza deta hain

verses.saheeh: Indeed, this was the clear trial.
verses.khattab: That was truly a revealing test
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Truly this, sacrifice to which he was commanded, was indeed a clear test’, that is to say, the ultimate test [of faith].
verses.romanUrdu: Yaqeenan yeh ek khuli aazmaaish thi”

verses.saheeh: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,
verses.khattab: And We ransomed his son with a great sacrifice
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Then We ransomed him, the one whom he had been commanded to sacrifice, namely, Ishmael or Isaac — two different opinions — with a mighty sacrifice, [a mighty] ram from Paradise, the same one that Abel had offered as as sacrifice: Gabriel, peace be upon him, brought it and the lord Abraham sacrificed it as he cried, Allāhu akbar, ‘God is Great’.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur humne ek badi qurbani fidiye mein de kar us bacchey ko chuda liya

verses.saheeh: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
verses.khattab: and blessed Abraham ˹with honourable mention˺ among later generations
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And We left, We preserved, for him among posterity, fair praise [namely]:
verses.romanUrdu: Aur uski taarif o tauseef hamesha ke liye baad ki nasalon mein chodh di

verses.saheeh: "Peace upon Abraham."
verses.khattab: “Peace be upon Abraham.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿‘Peace, from Us, be to Abraham!’
verses.romanUrdu: Salaam hai Ibrahim par

verses.saheeh: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
verses.khattab: This is how We reward the good-doers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So, in way that We rewarded him, do We reward those who are virtuous, to their own souls.
verses.romanUrdu: Hum neki karne waalon ko aisi hi jaza detay hain

verses.saheeh: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
verses.khattab: He was truly one of Our faithful servants
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Indeed he is one of Our faithful servants.
verses.romanUrdu: Yaqeenan woh hamare momin bandon mein se tha

verses.saheeh: And We gave him good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous.
verses.khattab: We ˹later˺ gave him good news of Isaac—a prophet, and one of the righteous
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And We gave him the good tidings of [the birth of] Isaac — some have argued that this proves that the one who was sacrificed was not him [Isaac] — a prophet (nabiyyan is a future circumstantial qualifier, that is to say, ‘he will come to be, with his prophethood decreed), one of the righteous.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur humne usey Ishaq(Issac) ki basharat di , ek Nabi saliheen mein se

wbw.translation: And We gave him glad tidings

verses.uthmani: وَبَٰرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسْحَٰقَ ۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌۭ وَظَالِمٌۭ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ مُبِينٌۭ
verses.indopak: وَبٰرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ وَعَلٰٓى اِسۡحٰقَ ؕ وَ مِنۡ ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحۡسِنٌ وَّظَالِمٌ لِّنَفۡسِهٖ مُبِيۡنٌ
verses.transliteration: wabarakna 'alayhi wa'ala ishaqa wamin thurriyyatihima muhsinun wathalimun linafsihi mubeenun
verses.saheeh: And We blessed him and Isaac. But among their descendants is the doer of good and the clearly unjust to himself.
verses.khattab: We blessed him and Isaac as well. Some of their descendants did good, while others clearly wronged themselves
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And We blessed him, by multiplying his descendants, and Isaac, his son, [We also blessed] by appointing the majority of prophets from among his progeny. And among their descendants is he who is virtuous, [he who is] a believer, and he who plainly wrongs his soul, [he who is] a disbeliever, whose disbelief is manifest.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur usey aur Ishaq ko barakat di. Ab in dono ki zurriyat mein se koi mohsin hai aur koi apne nafs par sareeh zulm karne wala hai

verses.saheeh: And We did certainly confer favor upon Moses and Aaron.
verses.khattab: And We certainly showed favour to Moses and Aaron
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And verily We favoured Moses and Aaron, with prophethood,
verses.romanUrdu: Aur humne Moosa o Haroon par ehsan kiya

verses.saheeh: And We saved them and their people from the great affliction,
verses.khattab: and delivered them and their people from the great distress
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and We delivered them and their people, the Children of Israel, from the great distress, namely, Pharaoh’s enslavement of them.
verses.romanUrdu: Unko aur unki qaum ko karb-e-azeem( badi museebat) se nijaat di

wbw.translation: And We saved both of them

verses.saheeh: And We supported them so it was they who overcame.
verses.khattab: We helped them so it was they who prevailed
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And We helped them, against the Egyptians, so that they became the victors.
verses.romanUrdu: Unhein nusrat bakshi jiski wajah se wahi galib rahey

verses.saheeh: And We gave them the explicit Scripture,
verses.khattab: We gave them the clear Scripture
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And We gave them the enlightening scripture, the one whose statements concerning prescribed punishments and rulings and otherwise are excellently expressed — this is the Torah.
verses.romanUrdu: Unko nihayat wazeh kitaab ata ki

wbw.translation: And We gave both of them

verses.saheeh: And We guided them on the straight path.
verses.khattab: and guided them to the Straight Path
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And We guided them to the straight path, [the straight] way,
verses.romanUrdu: Unhein raah-e-raast dikhayi

wbw.translation: And We guided both of them

verses.saheeh: And We left for them [favorable mention] among later generations:
verses.khattab: And We blessed them ˹with honourable mention˺ among later generations
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and We left, We preserved, for them among posterity, fair praise [namely]:
verses.romanUrdu: Aur baad ki nasalon mein unka zikr e khair baaqi rakkha

verses.saheeh: "Peace upon Moses and Aaron."
verses.khattab: “Peace be upon Moses and Aaron.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿‘Peace, from Us, be to Moses and Aaron!’
verses.romanUrdu: Salaam hai Mossa aur Haroon par

verses.saheeh: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
verses.khattab: Indeed, this is how We reward the good-doers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So, just as We rewarded them both, do We reward the virtuous.
verses.romanUrdu: Hum neki karne walon ko aisi hi jaza detay hain

verses.saheeh: Indeed, they were of Our believing servants.
verses.khattab: They were truly ˹two˺ of Our faithful servants
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Indeed both were among Our faithful servants.
verses.romanUrdu: Dar haqeeqat woh hamare momin bandon mein se thay

verses.saheeh: And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers,
verses.khattab: And Elias was indeed one of the messengers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And truly Elias (read [wa-inna Ilyās] with the initial hamza or without [wa-inna’l-yāsa) was [also] one of the messengers. Some think that this [Elias] was the son of Aaron’s brother — [Aaron] the brother of Moses; but some say that this [Elias] was some other [person], who was sent to the people living in and around Baalbak.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur Ilyas bhi yaqeenan mursaleen(messengers) mein se tha

verses.saheeh: When he said to his people, "Will you not fear Allah?
verses.khattab: ˹Remember˺ when he said to his people, “Will you not fear ˹Allah˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿When (idh is dependent because of an implicit [verb] udhkur, ‘mention’) he said to his people, ‘Will you not fear [God]?
verses.romanUrdu: Yaad karo jab usne apni qaum se kaha tha ke “tum log darte nahin ho

verses.saheeh: Do you call upon Ba'l and leave the best of creators -
verses.khattab: Do you call upon ˹the idol of˺ Ba’l and abandon the Best of Creators—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Do you call on Baal — this was the name of an idol of theirs which was made of gold, from which the name of their city derives, with the addition of [the suffix] bak — that is to say, do you worship him, and abandon the Best of Creators, and not worship Him,
verses.romanUrdu: Kya tum BAAL ko pukarte ho aur ahsanul khaliqeen ko chodh dete ho

verses.saheeh: Allah, your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers?"
verses.khattab: Allah, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿God, your Lord, and the Lord of your forefathers?’ (read [as predicates] allāhu, rabbukum and rabbu, in the nominative, because of the [implicit] omitted huwa [being the subject]; or read allāha, rabbakum and rabba, in the accusative, as supplements to ahsana, ‘the best of’).
verses.romanUrdu: Us Allah ko jo tumhara aur tumhare agle pichle aaba o ajdaad ka Rubb hai?”

verses.saheeh: And they denied him, so indeed, they will be brought [for punishment],
verses.khattab: But they rejected him, so they will certainly be brought ˹for punishment˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿But they denied him. So they will indeed be arraigned, in the Fire,
verses.romanUrdu: Magar unhon ne usey jhutla diya, so ab yaqeenan woh saza ke liye pesh kiye janey waley hain

verses.saheeh: Except the chosen servants of Allah.
verses.khattab: But not the chosen servants of Allah
verses.jalalayn: ﻿— [all] except God’s delivered servants, namely, the believers, who will be saved from it,
verses.romanUrdu: Bajuz un bandagaan e khuda ke jinko khaalis karliya gaya tha

verses.saheeh: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
verses.khattab: We blessed him ˹with honourable mention˺ among later generations
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and We left for him among posterity, fair praise [namely]:
verses.romanUrdu: Aur Ilyas ka zikr e khair humne baad ki nasalon mein baaki rakkha

verses.saheeh: "Peace upon Elias."
verses.khattab: “Peace be upon Elias.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿‘Peace, from Us, be to Elias!’. It is said that this [ilyāsīn] is [the same] Elias mentioned above; but it is also said that this denotes him together with [all] those who were believers with him, and so they have been coupled [under the same term] with him being the predominant, as when one might say al-Muhallabūn, ‘the Muhallabids’, to mean al-Muhallab and his folk; a variant reading has āl yāsīn, by which is meant his family as well as Elias himself.
verses.romanUrdu: Salaam hai Ilyas par

verses.saheeh: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
verses.khattab: Indeed, this is how We reward the good-doers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Indeed so — just as We rewarded him — do We reward the virtuous.
verses.romanUrdu: Hum neki karne walon ko aisi hi jaza dete hain

verses.saheeh: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
verses.khattab: He was truly one of Our faithful servants
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Truly he is one of Our faithful servants.
verses.romanUrdu: Waqayi wo hamare momin bandon mein se tha

verses.saheeh: And indeed, Lot was among the messengers.
verses.khattab: And Lot was indeed one of the messengers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And indeed Lot was one of the messengers;
verses.romanUrdu: Aur Lut bhi unhi logon mein se tha jo Rasool bana kar bheje gaye hain

verses.saheeh: [So mention] when We saved him and his family, all,
verses.khattab: ˹Remember˺ when We delivered him and all of his family
verses.jalalayn: ﻿mention, when We delivered him together with all his family,
verses.romanUrdu: Yaad karo jab humne usko aur uske sab gar walon ko nijaat di

verses.saheeh: Except his wife among those who remained [with the evildoers].
verses.khattab: except an old woman, who was one of the doomed
verses.jalalayn: ﻿except an old woman [who was] among those who stayed behind, in other words, those who stayed behind in the chastisement.
verses.romanUrdu: Siwaye ek budiya ke jo peechey reh janey walon mein se thi

verses.saheeh: Then We destroyed the others.
verses.khattab: Then We ˹utterly˺ destroyed the rest
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Then We destroyed [all] the others, the disbelievers from among his people.
verses.romanUrdu: Phir baaki sabko tehas nehas kardiya

verses.saheeh: And indeed, you pass by them in the morning
verses.khattab: You ˹Meccans˺ certainly pass by their ruins day
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And indeed you pass by them, by their remains and [the remains of] their dwellings during your travels, [both] in the morning, that is, during the daytime,
verses.romanUrdu: Aaj tum shab-o-roz unke ujday dayar (desolate habitations) par se guzarte ho

verses.saheeh: And at night. Then will you not use reason?
verses.khattab: and night. Will you not then understand
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and at night: will you, O people of Mecca, not then understand?, what befell them and so take heed therefrom?
verses.romanUrdu: Kya tumko aqal nahin aati

verses.saheeh: And indeed, Jonah was among the messengers.
verses.khattab: And Jonah was indeed one of the messengers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And indeed Jonah was one of the messengers;
verses.romanUrdu: Aur yaqeenan Yunus bhi Rasoolon mein se tha

verses.saheeh: [Mention] when he ran away to the laden ship.
verses.khattab: ˹Remember˺ when he fled to the overloaded ship
verses.jalalayn: ﻿when he fled to the laden ship — after he became furious with his people, as the chastisement which he had promised them did not come down on them; so he boarded the ship, which then stopped out in the deep sea. The seamen said, ‘There is a runaway slave here [upon this ship] who has fled from his master: a casting of lots should expose him!’
verses.romanUrdu: Yaad karo jab woh ek bhari kashti ki taraf bhaag nikla

verses.saheeh: And he drew lots and was among the losers.
verses.khattab: Then ˹to save it from sinking,˺ he drew straws ˹with other passengers˺. He lost ˹and was thrown overboard˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Then he drew lots, with the passengers on the ship, and was of those rejected, of the losers in the draw and so they threw him into the sea.
verses.romanUrdu: Phir quora andazi (cast lots) mein shareek hua aur usmein maath khayi (among the losers)

verses.saheeh: Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy.
verses.khattab: Then the whale engulfed him while he was blameworthy
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Then the whale swallowed him while he was blameworthy, that is, while he was guilty of a blameworthy thing, having gone to sea and embarked the ship without his Lord’s permission.
verses.romanUrdu: Aakhir e kaar machli ne usey nigal liya aur woh malamat zada tha

verses.saheeh: And had he not been of those who exalt Allah,
verses.khattab: Had he not ˹constantly˺ glorified ˹Allah˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And had he not been one of those who glorify [God], that is to say, those who make remembrance [of God], for inside the whale’s belly he was repeatedly saying [the words] ‘There is no god except You. Glory be to You! I have indeed been one of the wrongdoers’ [Q. 21:87],
verses.romanUrdu: Ab agar woh tasbeeh karne walon mein se na hota to

verses.uthmani: لَلَبِثَ فِى بَطْنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
verses.indopak: لَلَبِثَ فِىۡ بَطۡنِهٖۤ اِلٰى يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُوۡنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: lalabitha fee batnihi ila yawmi yub'athoona
verses.saheeh: He would have remained inside its belly until the Day they are resurrected.
verses.khattab: he would have certainly remained in its belly until the Day of Resurrection
verses.jalalayn: ﻿he would have tarried in its belly until the day when they are raised, in other words, the whale’s belly would have been his tomb until the Day of Resurrection.
verses.romanUrdu: Roz-e-qayamat tak usi machli ke pait mein rehta

verses.saheeh: But We threw him onto the open shore while he was ill.
verses.khattab: But We cast him onto the open ˹shore˺, ˹totally˺ worn out
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Then We cast him, We flung him out of the belly of the whale, onto the barren land, onto the face of the earth, that is, onto the shore on that same day — or three, or seven, or twenty, or forty days later — and he was sick, ailing like a [newly-born] featherless chick.
verses.romanUrdu: Aakhir humne usey badi sakheem (bimar /ill) halat mein ek chatiyal zameen par phenk diya

verses.saheeh: And We caused to grow over him a gourd vine.
verses.khattab: and caused a squash plant to grow over him
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And We made a gourd plant to grow above him, to provide shade for him with its stem, which is not the case usually with gourds, as a miracle for him; a mountain goat would come to him in the morning and in the evening and he would drink its milk, until he finally regained his strength.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur uspar ek bail-daar darakht (a spreading plant of the gourd kind) uga diya

verses.uthmani: وَأَرْسَلْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِا۟ئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ
verses.indopak: وَاَرۡسَلۡنٰهُ اِلٰى مِائَةِ اَلۡفٍ اَوۡ يَزِيۡدُوۡنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: waarsalnahu ila miati alfin aw yazeedoona
verses.saheeh: And We sent him to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more.
verses.khattab: We ˹later˺ sent him ˹back˺ to ˹his city of˺ at least one hundred thousand people
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And We sent him, afterwards — as [We had done] before, to a people in Nineveh, in the region of Mosul — to a [community of a] hundred thousand or, in fact, more — [a community of] twenty, thirty or seventy thousand.
verses.romanUrdu: Iske baad humne usey ek lakh ya us sey zayad logon ki taraf bheja

verses.saheeh: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time.
verses.khattab: who then believed ˹in him˺, so We allowed them enjoyment for a while
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And they believed, after they saw [with their own eyes] the chastisement which they had been promised. So We gave them comfort, We kept them alive to enjoy their wealth, for a while, until their terms [of life] would be concluded [while they took comfort] therein.
verses.romanUrdu: Woh imaan laye aur humne ek waqt e khaas tak unhein baaqi rakkha

verses.saheeh: So inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?
verses.khattab: Ask them ˹O Prophet˺ if your Lord has daughters, while the pagans ˹prefer to˺ have sons
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So ask them, inquire of the Meccan disbelievers, by way of reproach: are daughters to be for your Lord, after their claim that the angels were God’s daughters, while sons are to be for them?, so that the best becomes exclusively theirs?
verses.romanUrdu: Phir zara in logon se pucho, kya (inke dil ko yeh baat lagti hai ke) tumhare Rubb ke liye to hon betiyan aur inke liye hon betay

verses.uthmani: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَٰثًۭا وَهُمْ شَٰهِدُونَ
verses.indopak: اَمۡ خَلَقۡنَا الۡمَلٰٓٮِٕكَةَ اِنَاثًا وَّهُمۡ شٰهِدُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: am khalaqna almalaikata inathan wahum shahidoona
verses.saheeh: Or did We create the angels as females while they were witnesses?"
verses.khattab: Or ˹ask them˺ if We created the angels as females right before their eyes
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Or did We create the angels females while they were witnesses?, to Our [act of] creation, that they might then say such a thing?
verses.romanUrdu: Kya waqayi humne malaika (farishton) ko auratein banaya hai aur yeh aankhon dekhi baat keh rahey hain

verses.saheeh: Unquestionably, it is out of their [invented] falsehood that they say,
verses.khattab: Indeed, it is one of their ˹outrageous˺ fabrications to say
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Lo! it is indeed out of their [own] mendacity, their [own] lies, that they say,
verses.romanUrdu: Khoob sun rakkho, dar-asal yeh log apni mann ghadat se yeh baat kehte hain

verses.saheeh: " Allah has begotten," and indeed, they are liars.
verses.khattab: “Allah has children.” They are simply liars
verses.jalalayn: ﻿‘God has begotten’, when they say that the angels are God’s daughters. And verily they are liars, in this [respect].
verses.romanUrdu: Ke Allah aulad rakhta hai, aur fil waqayi yeh jhootey hain

verses.saheeh: Has He chosen daughters over sons?
verses.khattab: Has He chosen daughters over sons
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Has He preferred daughters to sons? (read a’stafā, ‘has He preferred’, indicating an interrogative [hamza], which stands in place of the omitted conjunctive hamza).
verses.romanUrdu: Kya Allah ne beton ke bajaye betiyan apne liye pasand karli

verses.saheeh: What is [wrong] with you? How do you make judgement?
verses.khattab: What is the matter with you? How do you judge
verses.jalalayn: ﻿What is wrong with you? How do you judge?, [how do you make] such a depraved judgement?
verses.romanUrdu: Tumhein kya ho gaya hai, kaise hukum laga rahey ho

verses.saheeh: Then will you not be reminded?
verses.khattab: Will you not then be mindful
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Will you not then remember? (tadhakkarūna: the tā’ [of tatadhakkarūna] has been assimilated with the dhāl), that He, glory be to Him, is exalted above having a child?
verses.romanUrdu: Kya tumhein hosh nahin aata

verses.saheeh: Or do you have a clear authority?
verses.khattab: Or do you have ˹any˺ compelling proof
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Or do you have a clear warrant?, plain definitive proof that God has a child?
verses.romanUrdu: Ya phir tumhare paas apni in baaton ke liye koi saaf sanad (daleel) hai

verses.saheeh: Then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful.
verses.khattab: Then bring ˹us˺ your scripture, if what you say is true
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Then produce your scripture, the Torah, and show Me this [as it is mentioned] in it, if you are being truthful, about this statement of yours.
verses.romanUrdu: To lao apni woh kitaab agar tum sachhey ho

verses.uthmani: وَجَعَلُوا۟ بَيْنَهُۥ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًۭا ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ ٱلْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
verses.indopak: وَجَعَلُوۡا بَيۡنَهٗ وَبَيۡنَ الۡجِنَّةِ نَسَبًا ؕ وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمَتِ الۡجِنَّةُ اِنَّهُمۡ لَمُحۡضَرُوۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: waja'aloo baynahu wabayna aljinnati nasaban walaqad 'alimati aljinnatu innahum lamuhdaroona
verses.saheeh: And they have claimed between Him and the jinn a lineage, but the jinn have already known that they [who made such claims] will be brought to [punishment].
verses.khattab: They have also established a ˹marital˺ relationship between Him and the jinn. Yet the jinn ˹themselves˺ know well that such people will certainly be brought ˹for punishment˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And they, namely, the idolaters, have set up between Him, exalted be He, and the jinn, namely, the angels (jinna: they are so called because they are hidden [ijtinān] from vision) a kinship, by saying that they are God’s daughters, while the jinn certainly know that they, that is, those who say this, shall indeed be arraigned, into the Fire, to be chastised therein.
verses.romanUrdu: Inhon ne Allah aur malaika ke darmiyan nasab (kinship)ka rishta bana rakkha hai, halanke malaika khoob jaante hain ke yeh log mujrim ki haisiyat se pesh honay waley hain

verses.saheeh: Exalted is Allah above what they describe,
verses.khattab: Glorified is Allah far above what they claim
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Glory be to God, affirming that He is exalted, above what they attribute, [to Him] in the way of His having a child,
verses.romanUrdu: (aur woh kehte hain ke) “Allah un sifaat se paak hai

verses.saheeh: Except the chosen servants of Allah [who do not share in that sin].
verses.khattab: But not the chosen servants of Allah
verses.jalalayn: ﻿— [all] except God’s devoted servants, namely, believers (the exceptive clause here is discontinuous) in other words, [that is] because they declare that God transcends what such individuals attribute [to Him].
verses.romanUrdu: Jo uske khaalis bandon ke siwa dusre log uski taraf mansoob karte hain

verses.saheeh: So indeed, you [disbelievers] and whatever you worship,
verses.khattab: Surely you ˹pagans˺ and whatever ˹idols˺ you worship
verses.jalalayn: ﻿For indeed you and what you worship, of idols,
verses.romanUrdu: Pas tum aur tumhare yeh mabood

verses.saheeh: You cannot tempt [anyone] away from Him
verses.khattab: can never lure ˹anyone˺ away from Him
verses.jalalayn: ﻿— you cannot tempt, anyone, thereto, that is, to [incline to] your [worshipped] idols (‘alayhi, ‘thereto’, is semantically connected to His saying [bi-fātinīna], ‘you cannot tempt’),
verses.romanUrdu: Allah se kisi ko pher nahin sakte

verses.saheeh: Except he who is to [enter and] burn in the Hellfire.
verses.khattab: except those ˹destined˺ to burn in Hell
verses.jalalayn: ﻿except him who will burn in Hell, in God’s knowledge, exalted be He.
verses.romanUrdu: Magar sifr usko jo dozakh ki bhadakti hui aag mein jhulasne wala ho

verses.uthmani: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامٌۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ
verses.indopak: وَمَا مِنَّاۤ اِلَّا لَهٗ مَقَامٌ مَّعۡلُوۡمٌ ۙ
verses.transliteration: wama minna illa lahu maqamun ma'loomun
verses.saheeh: [The angels say], "There is not among us any except that he has a known position.
verses.khattab: ˹The angels respond,˺ “There is not one of us without an assigned station ˹of worship˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Gabriel said to the Prophet (s): And there is not one of us, [us] the company of angels, but has a known station, in the heavens, in which he worships God and which he does not transgress.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur hamara haal to yeh hai ke hum mein se har ek ka ek muqaam mukarrar hai
