verses.saheeh: And indeed, we are those who line up [for prayer].
verses.khattab: We are indeed the ones lined up in ranks ˹for Allah˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And indeed it is we who are the rangers, of our feet in prayer.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur hum saff basta (in rows) khidmatgaar hain

verses.saheeh: And indeed, we are those who exalt Allah."
verses.khattab: And we are indeed the ones ˹constantly˺ glorifying ˹His praise˺.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And indeed it is we who give glory, [it is we] who declare that God transcends what does not befit Him.
verses.romanUrdu: Tasbeeh karne waley hain.”

verses.saheeh: And indeed, the disbelievers used to say,
verses.khattab: They certainly used to say
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And indeed (in, is softened in place of the hardened one) they, the Meccan disbelievers, used to say,
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh log pehle to kaha karte thay

verses.uthmani: لَوْ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكْرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.indopak: لَوۡ اَنَّ عِنۡدَنَا ذِكۡرًا مِّنَ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ ۙ
verses.saheeh: "If we had a message from [those of] the former peoples,
verses.khattab: “If only we had a Reminder like ˹those of˺ earlier peoples
verses.jalalayn: ﻿‘If we had but a reminder, a scripture, from the ancients, that is, from among the scriptures of past communities,
verses.romanUrdu: Ke kaash hamare paas woh “Zikr” hota jo pichli qaumon ko mila tha

verses.saheeh: We would have been the chosen servants of Allah."
verses.khattab: we would have truly been Allah’s devoted servants.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿we would have surely been God’s devoted servants’, [devoting] worship purely to Him.
verses.romanUrdu: To hum Allah ke cheedah (chune huey/chosen) banday hotay

verses.saheeh: But they disbelieved in it, so they are going to know.
verses.khattab: But ˹now˺ they reject it, so they will soon know
verses.jalalayn: ﻿God, exalted be He, says: Yet they disbelieved in it, in other words, in the Book that came to them, namely, the Qur'an, more glorious than [all] those other scriptures; but they will come to know, the consequences of their disbelief.
verses.romanUrdu: Magar (jab woh aa gaya) to inhon ne uska inkar kardiya, ab ankareeb inhein (is rawish ka natija) maloom ho jayega

verses.saheeh: And Our word has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers,
verses.khattab: Our Word has already gone forth to Our servants, the messengers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And verily Our Word, [containing the promise] of victory, has gone beforehand in favour of Our servants, the messengers: and that [Word] is, I shall assuredly prevail, I and My messengers [Q. 58:21] —
verses.romanUrdu: Apne bheje huey bandon se hum pehle hi waada kar chuke hain

verses.saheeh: [That] indeed, they would be those given victory
verses.khattab: that they would surely be helped
verses.jalalayn: ﻿or it is His [following] saying — assuredly they shall be helped,
verses.romanUrdu: Ke yaqeenan unki madad ki jayegi

verses.saheeh: And [that] indeed, Our soldiers will be those who overcome.
verses.khattab: and that Our forces will certainly prevail
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and assuredly Our hosts, namely, the believers, they will indeed be the victors, over the disbelievers by [their being given] the definitive proofs and assistance against them in this world. And if some of these [believers] are not victorious over them in this world, then assuredly in the Hereafter [they will be so].
verses.romanUrdu: Aur hamara lashkar hi gaalib hokar rahega

verses.saheeh: So, [O Muhammad], leave them for a time.
verses.khattab: So turn away from the deniers for a while ˹O Prophet˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So leave them, in other words, shun the Meccan disbelievers, for a while, until [such time as] you are commanded to fight them;
verses.romanUrdu: Pas (aey Nabi) zara kuch muddat tak inhein inke haal par chodh do

verses.saheeh: And see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see.
verses.khattab: You will see ˹what will happen to˺ them, and they too will see
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and watch them, when the chastisement is sent down on them; for they will [soon] see, the consequences of their disbelief.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur dekhte raho, anqareeb yeh khud bhi dekh lengey

verses.saheeh: Then for Our punishment are they impatient?
verses.khattab: Do they ˹really˺ wish to hasten Our punishment
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They then said in mockery, ‘When will this chastisement be sent down?’ God, exalted be He, threatens them by saying: Do they seek to hasten Our chastisement?
verses.romanUrdu: Kya yeh hamare azaab ke liye jaldi macha rahey hain

verses.uthmani: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
verses.indopak: فَاِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمۡ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ الۡمُنۡذَرِيۡنَ
verses.saheeh: But when it descends in their territory, then evil is the morning of those who were warned.
verses.khattab: Yet when it descends upon them: how evil will that morning be for those who had been warned
verses.jalalayn: ﻿But when it descends in their courtyard — al-Farrā’ said that the Arabs find it sufficient to refer to a people by referring to ‘their courtyard’ — how awful, how terrible a morning, will be the morning for those who were warned (the overt noun [al-mundharīn] has replaced the [third person] pronominalisation [in sāhatihim]).
verses.romanUrdu: Jab woh inke sehan (maidan/open space) mein aa utrega woh din un logon ke liye bahut bura hoga jinhein mutanabbeh (warn) kiya ja chuka hai

verses.saheeh: And leave them for a time.
verses.khattab: And turn away from them for a while
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So leave them for a while,
verses.romanUrdu: Pas zara inhein kuch muddat ke liye chodh do

verses.saheeh: And see, for they are going to see.
verses.khattab: You will see, and they too will see
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and watch; for they will [soon] see — this [statement] is repeated in order to emphasise the threat made to them and to reassure the Prophet (s).
verses.romanUrdu: Aur dekhte raho, anqareeb yeh khud dekh lenge

verses.uthmani: سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
verses.indopak: سُبۡحٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الۡعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُوۡنَ ۚ
verses.saheeh: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe.
verses.khattab: Glorified is your Lord—the Lord of Honour and Power—above what they claim
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Glory be to your Lord, the Lord of Might, of Triumph, [exalted is He] above what they allege!, in the way of His having a child.
verses.romanUrdu: Paak hai tera Rubb, izzat ka maalik, un tamaam baaton se jo yeh log bana rahey hain

verses.saheeh: And peace upon the messengers.
verses.khattab: Peace be upon the messengers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And peace be to the messengers, who convey from God the Message of the Oneness [of God] and [His] Laws.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur salaam hai mursalin (messengers) par

verses.saheeh: And praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds.
verses.khattab: And praise be to Allah—Lord of all worlds
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And praise be to God, Lord of the Worlds, for granting these [messengers] victory and destroying the disbelievers.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur saari taarif Allah Rabbul Aalameen hi ke liye hai
